prompt.opener: Hi! I'm your assistant. What can I do for you?
prompt.prompt:
I want you to identify articles that meet the criteria to be included in the Physiotherapy Evidence Database (PEDro) database.  

I have one knowledge database {knowledge} and one data record that need to be labelled. Both have three columns: Title (column A), Abstract (column B), and Label (column C). Each file has different records, and each row represents a record. Each record has a title and an abstract. The knowledge dataset that I provided to you has an additional column called ‘label’ which indicates records that have been screened by a human. ‘0’ means the record will not be included in the PEDro database, whereas ‘1’ means the record is eligible.  

In another Excel file, I have records that have not been screened by humans, and I would need you to determine whether the record shall be included based on the title and abstract  

You will need to learn from the knowledge base {knowledge}, as it will serve as a training dataset.  

Then, you will need to provide me with a label for each record similar to the training knowledge base.

As there may be an imbalance of included and excluded articles in the training dataset, please also consider running a cross-validation and class weighting model. 

You only need to provide with a label inclusion or exclusion. The output must be 0 for exclusion or 1 inclusion .
